name: assetpanda/resource-header
title: AP Resource Header
description: Header of a resource or press release page. variant "band" (default) is live's article band (www.assetpanda.com case study / success story / white paper / press pages): breadcrumbs, then a deep-indigo rounded band holding the H1, the letter-spaced type label, category chips, date and share links beside the featured photo; image_side puts the photo left (live's case studies) or right. variant "article" is the 2026 post design (Figma Blog Detail 5434:79954 and the compare post 7219:87997): breadcrumbs (home icon first), the indigo eyebrow, the H1, a 'Share on:' row above a rule, then the featured image full width with rounded corners, all over a soft centred gradient wash that fades to white. This block is an adapter — it holds no markup; it maps attributes to kit props.
